title: Final: objects in the scene
cards/0/task: Make the Earth twice as big, and let the Moon travel alongside it at a distance of 2.4. Three orbit steps.
cards/1/q: What do you write to rotate by 30°?
cards/1/explain: The third option converts in the opposite direction.
cards/2/q: A car wheel should turn along with the car. Which line gets in the way?
cards/2/explain: The wheel lives in the scene, not in the car. You need car.add(wheel).
cards/3/q: Make the Moon a satellite of the Earth
cards/3/explain: attach exists too: it keeps the world position when the parent changes. Here you want add.
cards/5/q: Which are true? Select all that apply.
cards/5/options/0: A child's position is measured from its parent
cards/5/options/1: A parent's scale also stretches the distances to its children
cards/5/explain: Scene is an Object3D too, so it does have a position.
cards/6/q: How do you build a solar system where the Earth moves in a circle?
cards/6/options/0: Put the Earth in a Group at the center, 4 units out, and rotate the group
cards/6/options/1: Set x and z by hand every frame with sin and cos; it is the only way
cards/6/explain: sin/cos works too, but a group is simpler, and the Earth's children come along for the ride.
cards/7/task: Fix the system: the Moon stays put while the Earth flies away. Two orbit steps.
